build_vqa_v2_dataset: run the build function to download and set up the VQA-v2 dataset files
download_vqa_v2_resources: download the VQA-v2 train val and test question and annotation zip files
check_vqa_v2_built: check if the VQA-v2 dataset has already been built in the datapath directory
remove_vqa_v2_outdated: remove outdated VQA-v2 dataset files before rebuilding the data directory
summarize_build_function: summarize the build function that downloads VQA-v2 resources and marks data as built
